summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, reporting the voting results from its annual meeting of shareholders held that day. All ten director nominees were elected, each receiving over 76% of votes cast, and KPMG LLP was appointed as auditor with 94.94% votes for. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure of meeting results, not a special situation event. As a TSX and NYSE-listed gold producer, the company filed under the foreign private issuer rules, covering standard AGM outcomes. There are no transactional elements, strategic changes, or unusual governance actions in this filing, making it a routine administrative report without special-situation characteristics.
